client: Ferrylane Freight
client_industry: logistics
start: 2020-09
end: 2020-12
engagement: hourly
stack:
- React

metrics:

The review is from: Ferrylane Freight
Rating: 5.0 out of 5

text: Tobias was easy to work with throughout the project and handled feedback well, which mattered a lot to us as requirements evolved. He was responsive when we asked for changes and kept the work moving without making things feel heavy. The live fleet dashboard performed as needed, with 1,800 trucks tracked live and updates getting from ping to screen in under 2 seconds. Would hire again.
